court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
case_name: Vijay Nandkishor Gupta vs Rita Vijay Gupta

parties.respondent_defendant: Rita Vijay Gupta and Ku. Achal Vijay Gupta, wife and minor daughter

acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: The applicant (husband) had filed H.M.P. No. 184/2013 seeking decree for restitution of conjugal rights under Section 9 of the Hindu Marriage Act. The trial Court granted decree in favour of the husband, directing the wife to resume cohabitation within one month. The wife challenged this judgment and decree before the District Court in appeal.

legal_principles.principle: A spouse who leaves the company of their partner without just and probable cause is not entitled to maintenance.
legal_principles.held: The finding recorded by the Civil Court in the judgment given in H.M.P. No. 184/2013 on 15/04/2015 that the wife has left company of the husband without any just and probable cause...
cited_cases: Vijay Nandkishor Gupta vs Rita Vijay Gupta, (2019)

legal_principles.principle: The execution of a decree passed by a trial court is not stayed unless specifically mentioned.
legal_principles.held: The advocate for the applicant has made a specific statement that the effect, operation and execution of the judgment and decree passed by the trial Court on 15/04/2015 is not stayed...

outcome.final_order: The applicant's appeal against the order passed by the subordinate Courts in the proceedings under the Protection of Women From Domestic Violence Act, 2005 was dismissed.

keywords: Protection of Women from DV Act
use_for_drafting: advising on restitution of conjugal rights
